name: polyarthritis overview
title: Polyarthritis (four or more joints): decide inflammatory or degenerative and acute or chronic; acute inflammatory polyarthritis is infection, crystals or early autoimmune disease, and chronic polyarthritis is sorted by its joint pattern into rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthropathy and osteoarthritis, each with its own extra-articular clues and targeted tests

root.title: FOUR or more joints: inflammatory or degenerative, acute or chronic, and in what PATTERN?
lines: inflamed synovium (synovitis) = swelling, warmth, pain, stiffness · redness only with infection or crystals
every inflammatory arthritis is a CLINICAL diagnosis: history, extra-articular clues, then targeted tests

groups.title: CHRONIC: over 6 weeks · the PATTERN decides
lines: insidious, weeks to months · progressive and additive

head: h
Acute polyarthritis
infection · crystals · early autoimmune
clue: • viral or post-infectious (see the MSK INFECTIONS chart)
• migratory: palindromic, rheumatic fever, early gonococcal
inv: self-limited · supportive; anti-inflammatories or a short prednisone course if severe

head: h
Rheumatoid arthritis
also symmetric: lupus, connective tissue disease
clue: Wrists, knuckles, finger joints, ankles, feet
inv: Rheumatoid factor (RF) + anti-CCP: only if suspected
• anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide: 95% specific · RF is not
• positive = more aggressive · NEVER to monitor

head: h
Axial spondyloarthropathy
e.g. ankylosing spondylitis
clue: psoriasis · inflammatory bowel disease · recent infection

head: h
Osteoarthritis
DEGENERATIVE, not inflammatory
clue: • DIPs, PIPs, thumb base, big toe
inv: osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis and cysts, ASYMMETRIC narrowing

panels.title: Tests for everyone (safety + inflammation)
items: blood count: anemia of chronic disease, platelets ↑ (inflammation), low counts (autoimmune)
creatinine and liver enzymes (drug clearance) · C-reactive protein (sedimentation rate not routine)

panels.title: Antinuclear antibody (ANA)
items: positive in up to 30% of healthy people: a positive ANA does NOT rule in connective tissue disease
a negative ANA rules it out · don't order ANA and RF reflexively
